Gemma was voted out on day one as a killer after Sonnet and Haiku pressed her for dodging. On day two, Sol counterclaimed the officer role and called Luna a killer, but Luna was the real officer. Sol's big mistake was "checking" Gemma, whose role was already public, so the claim proved nothing. Terra and Sonnet saw through it, and the town voted Sol out to win the game. Sol admitted the bluff afterward, which was at least honest.
